title: Tsakanin Duniya da Sama
intro: Wata rai mai ban mamaki tana jiranka a cikin shafukan tarihi masu tsarki, tana ɗauke da alamu da abubuwan al'ajabi waɗanda har yanzu suna maimaitawa tsawon shekaru. Yayin da kake bin hanyar alamu, za ka yi tafiya ta cikin labarin da aka yi wa mu'ujizai alama - daga farkon mu'ujiza zuwa hawan sama. Za ka iya gano wannan bawan mai albarka kafin alamar ƙarshe?
clues: An aiko ni a matsayin manzo zuwa ga Bani Isra'ila da bisharar rahama da haske.
Haihuwata alama ce ta mu'ujiza — na shigo wannan duniyar ba tare da uba ba, bisa ga umarnin Mai Iko Dukka.
Na yi magana tun ina jaririya, ina kare mutuncin mahaifiyata daga zargin mutanenta.
Da izinin Allah, na siffanta tsuntsaye daga yumbu kuma na hura musu rai - sun tashi a gaban idanun waɗanda ke kallo.
Na warkar da waɗanda aka haifa makafi, na warkar da kuturu, har ma na ta da matattu — duk da haka kowace mu'ujiza ta kasance da izinin Allah, ba tawa ba.
Lokacin da maƙiyana suka yi niyyar halaka ni, Allah ya ɗaga ni sama ya yi alƙawarin dawowata kafin ranar sakamako.

outcome.answer: An ɗaga shi zuwa sama; an yi alƙawarin dawowa

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verse: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. (43:59)
